description: AgniSentinel is an AI-powered web dashboard for the Flame in Freefall challenge, predicting fire risks in ISS microgravity. Built with React and FastAPI, it analyzes NASA combustion data (FLEX, ACME, BASS) using Python deep learning to forecast flame behavior. A Gemini API-driven Agentic AI provides autonomous, real-time safety protocols, while Three.js renders interactive 3D flame visuals.
